parole.significato: but (introducing a clause contrary to prior belief or in contrast with the preceding clause or sentence)
parole.testo: From muu (“other”), either based on: * the partitive singular form (muuta: “something else”; the -uu- would have first been shortened and the final vowel elided, thus mut(t) with reanalysis as mutta, perhaps via a development like ei juokse, muuta [kuin] kävelee (literally “isn't running, [not] othe
